### Summary

By [Sunday, August 30^th^]{style="color:#bb0000"},
you should ensure you can access the Ohio Supercomputer Center (OSC)
and the OSC Project for this course (`PAS3493`).

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
_If you have any questions about this or run into problems while setting up your OSC account,_
_contact Jelmer._
:::

### Why this is needed

You will do nearly all of your course work for this course "at" (after connecting to)
the Ohio Supercomputer Center (OSC), starting next Monday's class.
To access OSC, you need to have an OSC account.

Earlier this week, we added you to the OSC Project for this course (`PAS3493`).
Membership of this specific project allows you to access the course's shared files
and to reserve computing resources.
For those without an OSC account,
being added to this project will also allow you to create an OSC account.

### What you should do

<hr style="height:1pt; visibility:hidden;" />

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### If you don't have an OSC account yet

1. During this week, you should have received an email from OSC (<no-reply@osc.edu>),
   informing you that you were added to OSC Project `PAS3493`,
   with a link to create an account.
   Follow the instructions in the email to create your account.

   ::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
   At some point during the course, you'll have to actually type your password
   in a context where you won't be able to see what you are typing.
   We therefore recommend a password that is not extremely complicated or long.
   :::

2. Check that you can log in to OSC at <https://ondemand.osc.edu> using your username and password
   (it may take up to half an hour after you create your account for this to work).

#### If you already have an OSC account

1. During this week, you should have received an email from OSC (<no-reply@osc.edu>)
   informing you that you were added to OSC Project `PAS3493`.
   Make sure you received this email; otherwise, you don't need to activate anything.

2. Check that you can log in to OSC at <https://ondemand.osc.edu> using your
   OSC username and password.

:::
